# iHeart

> iHeart is a free audio platform for streaming live radio, podcasts, music stations, playlists, and artist content.

iHeart combines thousands of live radio stations with on-demand podcasts, artist radio, playlists, music discovery, and entertainment news. The site also includes local station pages, podcast and artist directories, genre hubs, and event coverage.

## Main Platform
- [iHeart Home](https://www.iheart.com/): Main entry point for live radio, podcasts, playlists, and music discovery.
- [Live Radio](https://www.iheart.com/live/): Browse and listen to thousands of live AM, FM, and digital radio stations.
- [Podcasts](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/): Explore podcast categories, featured shows, and on-demand episodes.
- [Artist Radio](https://www.iheart.com/artist/): Discover artist pages with songs, albums, and related stations.
- [Playlists](https://www.iheart.com/playlist/): Stream curated playlists across moods, genres, and activities.
- [Music](https://www.iheart.com/music/): Access music discovery, genres, artists, and featured listening collections.

## Live Radio & Stations
- [Live Radio Directory](https://www.iheart.com/live/): Central directory for local, national, and digital radio stations.
- [News & Talk Stations](https://www.iheart.com/live/country/US/city/new-york-ny-501/): Example city station listing for finding local news and talk radio.
- [Z100 New York](https://www.iheart.com/live/z100-new-york-1469/): Major Top 40 station page with live stream, schedule, and local content.
- [KIIS FM Los Angeles](https://www.iheart.com/live/1027-kiis-fm-los-angeles-1737/): Popular hit music station with live listening and show information.
- [106.7 Lite FM](https://www.iheart.com/live/1067-lite-fm-1471/): Adult contemporary station page with stream and programming details.
- [FOX Sports Radio](https://www.iheart.com/live/fox-sports-radio-4732/): National sports radio station with live shows and sports commentary.
- [BIN: Black Information Network](https://www.iheart.com/live/bin-black-information-network-7119/): 24/7 national news station focused on Black communities and issues.

## Podcasts
- [Podcast Directory](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/): Browse all podcasts by category, popularity, and network.
- [Stuff You Should Know](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/105-stuff-you-should-know-26940277/): Long-running educational podcast covering how things work and cultural topics.
- [The Daily Show: Ears Edition](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-the-daily-show-ears-edit-30925791/): Audio edition featuring interviews, satire, and current events segments.
- [On Purpose with Jay Shetty](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/867-on-purpose-with-jay-shetty-30589432/): Popular self-improvement podcast with interviews and wellness discussions.
- [The Ben Shapiro Show](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-the-ben-shapiro-show-30880183/): News and politics podcast with commentary and daily episodes.
- [Revisionist History](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-revisionist-history-28588652/): Malcolm Gladwell podcast reexamining overlooked events, ideas, and assumptions.
- [HowStuffWorks Podcasts](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/): iHeart-hosted podcast catalog including education, true crime, and entertainment shows.

## Music, Artists & Playlists
- [Music Hub](https://www.iheart.com/music/): Entry point for songs, artists, genres, and featured music collections.
- [Artist Directory](https://www.iheart.com/artist/): Browse artist profiles with top songs, albums, and biographies.
- [Taylor Swift](https://www.iheart.com/artist/taylor-swift-33221/): Artist page with top tracks, albums, station, and related artists.
- [Drake](https://www.iheart.com/artist/drake-35859/): Artist profile featuring popular songs, releases, and personalized radio.
- [Morgan Wallen](https://www.iheart.com/artist/morgan-wallen-656264/): Country artist page with songs, albums, and station listening options.
- [Today's Hits Playlist](https://www.iheart.com/playlist/todays-hits-312064750-VeQJ7mTnMaHf0sPp7LhH3n/): Curated playlist of current popular tracks across mainstream genres.
- [Chill Playlist](https://www.iheart.com/playlist/chill-312064750-9Vv0wM0uohsEiL41Z8nfdX/): Mood-based playlist for relaxed listening and background music.

## Genres & Categories
- [Pop](https://www.iheart.com/genre/pop-36/): Genre hub for pop artists, stations, and playlists.
- [Country](https://www.iheart.com/genre/country-24/): Country music discovery page with artists, stations, and playlists.
- [Hip Hop](https://www.iheart.com/genre/hip-hop-38/): Hip hop genre page for artists, tracks, and radio stations.
- [Rock](https://www.iheart.com/genre/rock-39/): Rock music hub featuring stations, playlists, and artist content.
- [Alternative](https://www.iheart.com/genre/alternative-5/): Alternative genre page with curated listening and artist discovery.
- [R&B](https://www.iheart.com/genre/r-b-33/): R&B discovery page with songs, artists, and themed stations.
- [Latin](https://www.iheart.com/genre/latin-111/): Latin music hub for artists, playlists, and radio listening.
- [Christian & Gospel](https://www.iheart.com/genre/christian-gospel-16/): Faith-based music category with stations and artist pages.

## News & Entertainment
- [Music News](https://www.iheart.com/content/): Editorial hub for music, celebrity, podcast, and entertainment stories.
- [Trending News](https://www.iheart.com/content/): Browse featured headlines and current entertainment coverage.
- [Artist News](https://www.iheart.com/artist/): Artist pages often include related news, releases, and updates.
- [Podcast News](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/): Podcast hub highlights new shows, episodes, and featured creators.
- [Station News](https://www.iheart.com/live/): Local station pages include regional news, events, and show updates.

## Events & Awards
- [iHeartRadio Music Awards](https://www.iheart.com/music-awards/): Official awards site with nominees, winners, performances, and event coverage.
- [iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour](https://www.iheart.com/jingle-ball/): Annual concert event hub with lineup, dates, and ticket information.
- [iHeartCountry Festival](https://www.iheart.com/iheartcountry-festival/): Country music event page with artist lineup and festival details.
- [iHeartRadio ALTer EGO](https://www.iheart.com/alterego/): Alternative music event featuring performances from major artists.
- [iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina](https://www.iheart.com/fiesta-latina/): Latin music event page with performers and show information.
- [iHeartRadio Podcast Awards](https://www.iheart.com/podcast-awards/): Awards program recognizing podcasts, creators, and categories.

## Apps & Devices
- [iHeart Apps](https://www.iheart.com/apps/): Download iHeart apps for mobile, desktop, and connected devices.
- [iOS App](https://www.iheart.com/apps/): Access iHeart on iPhone and iPad for radio, podcasts, and music.
- [Android App](https://www.iheart.com/apps/): Access iHeart on Android phones and tablets.
- [Smart Speakers](https://www.iheart.com/apps/): Listen through Alexa, Google Assistant, and other voice-enabled devices.
- [Connected TV & Streaming Devices](https://www.iheart.com/apps/): Use iHeart on Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, and similar platforms.
- [Wearables & Auto](https://www.iheart.com/apps/): Listen in cars and on supported wearable devices.

## Account, Subscription & Support
- [iHeart Plus](https://www.iheart.com/subscribe/): Subscription plans for ad-free listening, unlimited skips, and offline features.
- [Subscription Options](https://www.iheart.com/subscribe/): Compare available paid plans and premium listening benefits.
- [Help Center](https://help.iheart.com/): Support portal for account, billing, app, and playback issues.
- [Contact Support](https://help.iheart.com/hc/en-us): Customer support entry point with searchable help articles.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.iheart.com/terms/): Legal terms governing use of the iHeart platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.iheart.com/privacy/): Privacy information covering data collection, cookies, and user choices.
